TikTok Hashtag Generator

Generate niche-targeted TikTok hashtag sets with one-click copy.

Hashtag set

📖 How to use

  1. Type your niche or topic.
  2. Choose a mix: balanced, broad reach, or niche-targeted.
  3. Click Generate Hashtags.
  4. Copy the set and paste it into your TikTok caption.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I generate hashtags?

Type your niche (e.g. fitness, cooking), pick a mix style, and click Generate — you get a ready-to-paste hashtag set.

Where do the hashtags come from?

Curated hashtag banks per niche, combining high-reach broad tags with specific niche tags for discovery.

Broad or niche hashtags?

The tool mixes broad tags (#fyp, #viral) with niche-specific ones so you reach both wide and targeted audiences.

Can I copy the set?

Yes — click Copy Hashtags to copy the whole set, ready to paste into TikTok.
